LocaleLayout.title: Startup Utah — Resources, programs, and capital for Utah founders
LocaleLayout.description: Discover Utah-based accelerators, grants, capital, mentors, and operator resources curated for early-stage founders. Backed by the State of Utah's Startup State initiative.

AdminResources.heading: Resource moderation
AdminResources.intro: Bulk directory data comes from CSV via {seedCmd} ({importCmd} in batches; requires a linked Convex project). Growing the catalog afterward happens here by approving submissions — or via future inline create/edit in admin.
AdminResources.access: Access: Convex deployment variables {clerkVar} (see convex/auth.config.ts + Convex/Clerk docs) and {adminEmailsVar} including your Clerk user email.
AdminResources.convexHint: Convex dashboard → set {clerkVar} + {adminEmailsVar} → run {devCmd}; open this admin route signed in as a user whose email is in ADMIN_EMAILS.

actions.addRejectionNote: Add a rejection note before rejecting.

accessDenied.signed_out: Convex does not see a signed-in user. Add JWT auth in convex/auth.config.ts (Clerk integration) so tokens from this app validate on the Convex deployment.
accessDenied.missing_email_in_token: Your session has no email claim for Convex. In Clerk, finish the Convex integration so JWTs include your primary email.
accessDenied.not_configured: ADMIN_EMAILS is not set on this Convex deployment. Add it under Convex → Settings → Environment variables (comma-separated emails).
accessDenied.not_in_allowlist: Signed-in email is not in ADMIN_EMAILS. Add your Clerk primary email (lowercase) on the Convex deployment.

Dashboard.title: My businesses — Utah Startup State
Dashboard.heading: My businesses
Dashboard.blurb: Edit the company information that appears on the Utah Startup Map.
Dashboard.emptyBody: Claim your company on the map and you'll be able to edit its details here. Edits go live and a record is sent to GOED for review.

edit.fieldDescriptionHint: A short summary that appears on the company card.
edit.adminBannerBody: This isn't a company you've claimed. Your changes show up in the Edit history section below alongside owner edits.

brief.title: Investor brief
brief.subtitle: What investors see when they open your profile. Edits replace the AI-extracted version.
brief.differentiationHint: One sentence on what sets you apart from competitors.
brief.notableCustomersHint: Press Enter or comma to add.
brief.integrationsHint: Press Enter or comma to add.

location.heading: Location
location.subtitle: The address that places your pin on the map. Saving re-geocodes via Mapbox.
location.placeholder: 123 Main St, Salt Lake City, UT
location.hint: Street, city, and state work best — the more specific, the more accurate the pin.
location.currentNoCoords: No coordinates on file — your business won't appear on the map until this resolves.
location.warnGeocodeFailed: We saved the address but couldn't resolve it to coordinates, so the pin won't show on the map yet. Try a more specific address.

photos.heading: Photos
photos.subtitle: Office shots, product imagery, team photos. Shown on your map listing.
photos.hint: Up to {max} photos. JPEG, PNG, or WebP under {sizeMb} MB.
photos.errorBadType: {name} isn't a supported image type (JPEG, PNG, or WebP).

history.heading: Edit history
history.subtitle: Every change to this company, newest first. Owner and admin edits appear here side by side.

listings.heading: Job listings
listings.subtitle: Open roles shown on your map listing.
listings.linkedinWarning: From LinkedIn — edits will be overwritten on the next scrape.

RegisterCompany.title: Add your business — Utah Startup State
RegisterCompany.heading: Add your business to the map
RegisterCompany.blurb: Tell us about your company and we'll get it on the Utah Startup Map after a quick review.
RegisterCompany.fieldWebsiteHint: We'll use this to show your logo and verify your claim later.
RegisterCompany.fieldDescriptionHint: One or two sentences. This appears on the map card.
RegisterCompany.fieldSubmitterEmailHint: We'll reach out at this address to confirm and verify the listing.
RegisterCompany.successBody: GOED will review your submission and reach out at the email you provided. Most submissions are processed within a few business days.

ClaimCompany.title: Claim your business — Utah Startup State
ClaimCompany.heading: Claim {name}
ClaimCompany.blurb: Tell us a bit about yourself so we can verify you work at this {sector} company. Once approved, you'll be able to edit the listing.
ClaimCompany.fieldEmailHint: Use a work email address — we'll send a verification link here.
ClaimCompany.fieldEmailHintWithDomain: Use an email at {domain} if you can — it speeds up verification.
ClaimCompany.fieldNotesHint: If your work email is on a different domain, briefly tell us why.
ClaimCompany.successBody: GOED will review your claim for {name} and email you with next steps. You'll get a link to set up your account once approved.
ClaimCompany.alreadyClaimedBody: {name} already has an owner. If that's a mistake, email goed@utah.gov.
ClaimCompany.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong. You can search the map or submit a new listing.
